ruleDefinitions.name: Multi Factor Authentication Disabled For User Account
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects changes to the "StrongAuthenticationRequirement" value, where the state is set to "0" or "Disabled".
Threat actors were seen disabling multi factor authentication for users in order to maintain or achieve access to the account. Also see in SIM Swap attacks.
 Note: Unmapped fields: LoggedByService, Category, OperationName, TargetResources.ModifiedProperties.DisplayName, TargetResources.ModifiedProperties.NewValue

sequences.query: (LoggedByService = "Core\ Directory" AND Category = "UserManagement" AND OperationName = "Update\ user" AND TargetResources.ModifiedProperties.DisplayName = "StrongAuthenticationRequirement" AND TargetResources.ModifiedProperties.NewValue = RGX(".*State\\"\\:0.*"))
